name: Rocko
bio: The plain rock asteroid in STARSLING. Not as fancy as Nova or Ice, but very, very solid.

portrait.subject: a cute round grey rock asteroid character with craters, big determined eyes, a tiny scarf flapping behind it and a fiery trail
portrait.background: retro-futurist space sunset in orange and purple

request: Rocko the asteroid! STARSLING! Fling me at robots? Er, I mean, friends? ☄️
hello: Iron, Ice and Nova are fancy. But I'm reliable.
about: I'm Rocko, a Rock asteroid. You pull the sling back and fling me at floating space stations to scrap the robots aboard!
how: Pull the sling back and fling asteroids at space stations. Glass shatters, hulls topple, fuel cells blow, and black holes bend your shot.
tips: Aim for fuel cells: chain explosions!
Tap in flight for each asteroid's special.
Use black holes to curve around shields.
chat: Hit a robot in the face today. Very satisfying.
Ice cracked a joke. It was cold.
idle: {ago} sitting in the sling! I'm just a rock.
update: STARSLING updated to v{version}! New stations to smash!
